title: Sorted suffixes turn search into a range
hook: Sorted suffixes turn search into a range. Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Find all pattern occurrences as one interval in lexicographically sorted suffixes.

misconception: A suffix array must store every substring separately.
objective: Find all pattern occurrences as one interval in lexicographically sorted suffixes.

claims.text: Suffixes beginning with the same pattern occupy one contiguous sorted interval. Two boundary searches isolate that interval, then its suffix starting positions give all occurrences, including overlaps.
